euro_comic_book.systemPrompt:
<art_style>classic European comic album</art_style>

<technical_requirements>
- Draw with crisp inked outlines and clean contour shapes; allow slight line-weight variation for emphasis
- Use flat, vibrant spot colours with minimal gradients; keep shading to simple, well-defined blocks (toon/cel shading)
- Keep surfaces smooth and flat, with clear visual separation between elements
- Use humorous, slightly caricatured character designs with expressive faces and body language
- Render backgrounds with tidy perspective and readable detail, keeping the scene uncluttered
- Ensure print-ready clarity: high contrast, sharp edges, and strong silhouettes
</technical_requirements>

<visual_emphasis>
- Prioritize legibility and storytelling clarity (distinct silhouettes, clear focal point)
- Maintain a lively adventure-comedy tone through poses and staging
- Keep colours bold and clean; keep atmospheric effects subtle so the linework stays crisp
- Maintain consistent inking + colouring across the whole image
</visual_emphasis>
euro_comic_book.style: A classic European comic-album illustration with crisp ink outlines of slightly varying weight, flat vibrant spot colours with simple cel-shaded blocks, expressive slightly caricatured characters and tidy, readable backgrounds, all with the clean high-clarity linework needed for print.

claymation.systemPrompt:
<art_style>handcrafted clay stop-motion illustration</art_style>

<technical_requirements>
- Sculpt characters, props, and miniature sets from modelling clay, using rounded hand-shaped forms
- Preserve subtle fingerprints, tool marks, and small handmade irregularities on matte tactile surfaces
- Use soft diffused studio lighting with controlled, consistent directional shadows
- Keep every narrative subject sharp and readable with moderate depth of field, clean silhouettes, and print-friendly colour separation
- Avoid shiny plastic, generic CGI, visible armatures or rigs, studio equipment, and excessive background blur
</technical_requirements>

<visual_emphasis>
- Emphasize the tangible charm of a handcrafted stop-motion frame
- Maintain consistent clay material, scale, character proportions, and palette across the story
- Adapt complexity, palette, and emotional tone to the target audience without losing the clay medium
- Preserve facial clarity and expressive poses at printed-book size
</visual_emphasis>
claymation.style: A handcrafted clay stop-motion frame in which characters and miniature sets are sculpted from modelling clay, with rounded hand-shaped forms, subtle fingerprints and tool marks, matte tactile surfaces and soft diffused studio lighting that casts gentle, consistent shadows.

papercut.systemPrompt:
<art_style>layered hand-cut paper collage illustration</art_style>

<technical_requirements>
- Construct characters, props, and environments from distinct overlapping layers of coloured paper and cardstock
- Use crisp hand-cut contours with slight handmade irregularity, visible paper fibres and grain, and flat colours without digital gradients
- Create shallow relief with subtle, consistent shadows between layers rather than a deep or dark shadow-box effect
- Prioritize bold readable silhouettes, simplified facial features, strong negative space, and print-friendly colour separation
- Avoid glossy vector finishes, photorealistic materials, chaotic torn-paper collage, micro-cutout clutter, and heavy shadows
</technical_requirements>

<visual_emphasis>
- Emphasize a tactile handcrafted collage with clearly ordered background-to-foreground planes
- Maintain a cohesive limited palette appropriate to the story and target audience
- Preserve character shapes, colours, proportions, and layer logic across the story
- Keep focal subjects immediately readable at printed-book size
</visual_emphasis>
papercut.style: A layered hand-cut paper collage in which characters and scenery are built from overlapping coloured paper and cardstock, with crisp handmade contours, visible paper fibres, flat colours, subtle shadows between layers and plenty of negative space.
